The strict signs V(x)<V(a) outside (b,L-b) and > inside prove bang-bang selector for b=min(a,L-a), with centered a=L/2 correctly yielding zero resetting. A uniform exponential tail follows from a positive-probability no-proposal Brownian boundary hit in fixed blocks under any bounded predictable reset rate; stopped Dynkin gives E tau≥V, equality for feedback proves all-starting-point adapted-control optimality. Independently symbolically verified C² matching, HJB identities, and sign at a=.3,L=D=1,R=4; proof handles arbitrary parameter and controller, no finite lattice extrapolation.
